description: This file implements MIME type utility functions, including MIME type lookup from file extensions, MIME type matching, and MIME boundary generation, primarily used within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: MimeUtil
classes.description: Singleton utility class for MIME type operations, including lookup and matching functions.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type from a file path.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Gets a well-known MIME type from extension without platform override.

methods.name: GetPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Returns preferred file extension for a given MIME type.

methods.name: MatchesMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type matches a pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: ParseMimeTypeWithoutParameter
methods.description: Parses MIME type string into top-level type and subtype.

methods.name: IsValidTopLevelMimeType
methods.description: Validates if a MIME top-level type is recognized.

methods.name: GetExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves file extensions associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: GenerateMimeMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Creates a unique MIME multipart boundary string.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUpload
methods.description: Appends a form-data part with value to multipart upload data.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUploadWithFileName
methods.description: Appends a file part with filename to multipart upload data.

methods.name: AddMultipartFinalDelimiterForUpload
methods.description: Appends the final boundary delimiter for multipart upload.

methods.name: ExtractMimeTypeFromMediaType
methods.description: Extracts MIME type from media type string, optionally accepting comma-separated types.
